summary.key_theme: 市場對混合雲與超融合基礎架構需求強勁，分析師持續調升目標價，儘管面臨高層人事異動挑戰。

bullish.title: Needham Maintains Buy on Nutanix, Raises Price Target to $90
bullish.reason: Needham 分析師 Matthew Calitri 將目標價從 85 美元上調至 90 美元，反映了對公司成長前景的強烈信心。

bullish.title: Nutanix (NTNX) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift As Analysts Back Hybrid Cloud Demand
bullish.reason: 市場公允價值模型從 58.98 美元上調，顯示機構投資人對其混合雲業務的估值溢價提升。

bullish.title: Nutanix (NASDAQ:NTNX): Strong Growth Meets a High-Quality Technical Setup
bullish.reason: 公司在成長性、獲利能力及技術圖表表現上均獲得高分，顯示強勁的動能支撐。

bullish.title: Wall Street Bulls Look Optimistic About Nutanix (NTNX): Should You Buy?
bullish.reason: 平均經紀商建議 (ABR) 顯示該股適合納入投資組合，市場共識偏向正面。

bullish.title: Nutanix (NTNX) Stock May Be 12% Undervalued As Managed Cloud Expands
bullish.reason: 分析指出其管理式雲端業務的擴張可能意味著股價仍有 12% 的上漲空間。

bearish.title: Nutanix (NTNX) Reshapes Sales Leadership As Tarkan Maner Exits
bearish.reason: 總裁兼商務長 Tarkan Maner 離職，銷售領導層變動可能引發市場對短期銷售策略穩定性的擔憂。

bearish.title: ChronoScale: 50MW Microsoft Win Is A Start, But More Capacity May Be Needed

neutral.title: Nutanix (NTNX) Laps the Stock Market: Here's Why
neutral.reason: 僅為單日股價波動回顧，漲幅 1.58% 屬於正常市場震盪範圍。

neutral.title: Hyper Converged Infrastructure Market Report 2026
